carte.slogan: We play. We meet. We connect.
carte.atout1Texte: You play with people you don't know yet.
carte.atout2Texte: A host leads the night: everything is played in the room, together.
carte.atout3Texte: Every game earns points for your team.
carte.videAide: It will appear here as soon as it opens.
carte.etape1: Join the game with your first name. Want to lead your team? Volunteer as captain!
carte.etape2: The host forms the teams: yours shows up on your phone.
carte.etape3: Follow the big screen: the games come one after another, all played in the room!
carte.etape4: Help your team win: the podium is revealed at the end of the night!
carte.nousHistoire: Team Up! began as an idea dreamt up within a family: bringing guests together in mixed teams, from the shyest to the most outgoing, from the youngest to the oldest, to share an unforgettable moment.
carte.nousAnimation: Team games, accessible challenges and a host who gets the room going.
carte.nousEquipe: We are a team of five, working on the project since early 2026: the game, the platform and everything that makes the experience unique.
carte.nousSuite: This is only the beginning: new games are coming soon. Follow the adventure!
